Class Library

java.lang.Object
Library
public class Library extends Object
Manages the user's collection of media entries in a single polymorphic list of MediaEntry objects. Because the list is declared to hold MediaEntry, it can store Movie, TVSeries, and VideoGame objects side by side and operate on all of them through the shared base type.

Provides operations to add, remove, find, filter, search, and summarize the contents of the library.

  • Method Details

    • addEntry

      public void addEntry(MediaEntry entry)
      Adds a MediaEntry to the library. Accepts any subclass of MediaEntry, namely Movie, TVSeries, or VideoGame.

      Precondition: entry is not null
      Postcondition: the entry is appended to the list

      Parameters:
      entry - the MediaEntry object to add

    • removeEntry

      public boolean removeEntry(String title)
      Removes the entry with the given title from the library, ignoring case.

      Precondition: title is not null
      Postcondition: the matching entry is removed from the list

      Parameters:
      title - the title of the entry to remove
      Returns:
      true if an entry was found and removed, false if no matching entry was found

    • findEntry

      public MediaEntry findEntry(String title)
      Searches the library for the first entry whose title matches the given title, ignoring case.

      Precondition: title is not null
      Postcondition: the library contents are unchanged

      Parameters:
      title - the title to search for
      Returns:
      the matching MediaEntry, or null if no entry with that title exists in the library

    • filterByStatus

      public ArrayList<MediaEntry> filterByStatus(MediaStatus status)
      Builds a list of every entry whose status matches the given MediaStatus.

      Precondition: status is not null
      Postcondition: the library contents are unchanged

      Parameters:
      status - the MediaStatus to filter by
      Returns:
      a list of entries matching the given status

    • filterByType

      public ArrayList<MediaEntry> filterByType(String type)
      Builds a list of every entry belonging to the given media type. The media type is matched case-insensitively against the labels returned by getMediaType, namely "Movie", "TVSeries", and "VideoGame".

      Precondition: type is not null
      Postcondition: the library contents are unchanged

      Parameters:
      type - the type of media to filter by
      Returns:
      a list of entries matching the given media type

    • searchEntries

      public ArrayList<MediaEntry> searchEntries(String keyword)
      Builds a list of every entry whose title or genre contains the given keyword, ignoring case.

      Precondition: keyword is not null
      Postcondition: the library contents are unchanged

      Parameters:
      keyword - the keyword to search for in titles and genres
      Returns:
      a list of entries matching the keyword

    • getAllEntries

      public ArrayList<MediaEntry> getAllEntries()
      Returns the complete list of entries in the library.
      Returns:
      the list of all MediaEntry objects

    • getSummary

      public String getSummary()
      Builds a summary string reporting the total number of entries in the library, the count of each media type, and the average rating across every entry that has been rated. Since a rating can only be attached to a COMPLETED entry, every rated entry is necessarily a completed one.

      Postcondition: the library contents are unchanged

      Returns:
      a String summarizing total entries, per-type counts, and the average rating of completed entries
